methodology.Crown_price: Original49 precomputed full-path T1; expanded15 exact T6/T3/T1 event replay T1; historical source-event replay only.
methodology.form: Trailing 365-day completed-match goal difference by provider league/team ID, cutoff before target Beijing date minus 3 days; 0 card matches is represented as missing delta plus explicit missing indicator, not as zero red cards.
methodology.red_adjustment: Per training fold, estimate beta from prior-year Crown card-complete records: sum(net red advantage * goal difference) / sum(net red advantage squared); adjust team form by subtracting beta times average opponent-red-minus-team-red. This is associational, not causal.
methodology.training: 2024 uses target rows before 2024; 2025 before 2025; 2026 before 2026. Ridge alpha=100, fold-local standardization; target label is home AH netU minus away AH netU at the actual Crown line and prices; choose larger predicted payoff, no EV gate.
methodology.AH settlement: Each side settled from Crown handicap and decimal price; quarter-lines split into two equal stakes.
methodology.time_status: Crown quotes are historical event-time replays. Card information has no verified historical publication/receipt time. No real receipt profit claim.
